name: Richmond Park March Half Marathon & 10K
course: Four-lap half on trails, pavement and grass through rolling parkland.
transport: Village by Sheen Gate; allow walking time from Mortlake or Richmond stations.
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and event village.
rules: No formal cutoff, but contact organiser if expecting over three hours. Half pack collection 08:00–09:00.
reason: The four laps and 187m ascent change the pacing equation; on-day pack collection closes 30 minutes before the half start.

name: Victoria Park March Running Festival
course: Flat, broad park paths; check separate starting points for each distance.
transport: St Marks Gate hub; public transport recommended due to limited nearby parking.
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and event village.
rules: This edition is on Friday, not the usual weekend; check work and travel plans before entry.
reason: The Friday date makes this a distinct option for runners free on weekdays. Its flat park route supports controlled pace efforts.

name: Chase the Moon Battersea Park March
start: Evening race; collect packs 17:30–18:30 and confirm final gun time.
course: Flat tarmac park laps after dark; water provided each lap.
transport: Battersea Park station is about ten minutes' walk; paid park parking available.
facilities: Bag drop, toilets and lap water.
rules: Use visible running kit for the evening; contact organiser if expecting over 90 minutes on 10K.
reason: A weekday evening race with a firm 10K reopening limit. The pack window and after-dark conditions are the key planning details.

name: Heaton Park March Running Festival
course: Undulating tarmac park paths; water and toilets about every 5km, except no course water for 5K.
transport: Pay-and-display parking; Heaton Park or Bowker Vale Metrolink stops with a walk to start.
facilities: Bag drop, toilets and chip timing; village opens 08:00.
rules: Half pack collection 08:15–09:15. Allow 10–20 minutes' walk from park entrances.
reason: The 273m half ascent makes this a demanding park course. Multiple entrances and a walk to the start need to be built into arrival time.
